results.name: Analysis mounts once above recovery and owns a separate central workspace
Native file-change handler uses an explicit display override for the shell-hidden picker
Raw binary opens without emulator or engine profile and preserves project/history
Unknown mapper has full physical inspection with CPU addresses unknown
NROM header mappings remain explicit and mirrored physical banks navigate separately
Two distinct user banks can share a CPU window without flattening physical identity
Range validation rejects invalid offset, window wrap and variant without losing selection
Large files render bounded pages and keep physical offsets through paging
Literal untrusted filenames, annotations and bank labels do not become markup
A delayed earlier file read cannot replace a later successful inspection
A delayed model result is ignored after another file selection
Oversized and failed reads preserve the current inspection and notes
Empty files produce an identity without invented addresses or instructions
Search includes chunk-boundary patterns and navigation uses physical file offsets
Search results are capped with an explicit resumable next offset
Search can be cancelled between bounded chunks and stale work cannot alter a new file
Inspection export contains report, user mappings and annotations through Save As
Save failure or cancellation retains notes; new successful file resets them
Invalid search and annotations report errors without editor mutation
General analysis view toggles preserve existing emulator disassembly contents
Raw CHR preview reads physical banks in grayscale without claiming scene palettes
Missing CHR data stays explicitly unknown and malformed paging leaves state intact
